skills.name: Mystic Arts Mastery
skills.description: Channels the flow of your magic to strengthen you.

skills.name: Specter State
skills.description:
Part of your body links to the Abyss and transforms into the Specter.
Specter skills are powerful, but using this too often will activate your Specter state which tears at your soul and depletes your Spectra very quickly.
Consumed Spectra can be slowly recovered while in your Flora state.
Non-cash equipment is not visible even when equipped. Cape is not visible while in Specter-ridden state.

skills.name: Basic Buff
skills.description: Increases Speed and Knockback Resistance when Basic Cast hits.

skills.name: Spectra Fatigue
skills.description: You remained in Specter State too long and depleted your Spectra. Spectra will not be restored for a while.

skills.name: Mystic Leap
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI. effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Basic Charge Drive
skills.description:
Uses magically-enhanced strength to attack your enemies. Charges Basic Cast when the attack hits.
Can link to any skill. The skills linked with Basic Charge Drive can be moved with directional keys.
Can only be used in Flora State.

skills.name: Ominous Nightmare
skills.description: Inflict extreme lacerations on enemies using your specter hand. Shifts to Ominous Dream in Specter State.

skills.name: Spell Bullets
skills.description:
Shoots all charged spells at once, like bullets. You can only charge non-Basic spells once each.
Charged spells are unaffected by attack reflection.
In Auto Mode, rather than being charged, the shots manifest as Spell Bullets.
Auto Mode on/off: Right-click

skills.name: Mystic Leap
skills.description:
Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same to move upward.
In Specter State, this skill is upgraded to Instinctual Leap.
Instinctual Leap Float Command Lock: Right-click
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Ominous Dream
skills.description:
Inflict extreme lacerations on enemies using your specter hand. Shifts to Ominous Nightmare in Flora State.
Can link to any skill. The skills linked with Ominous Dream can be moved with directional keys.

skills.name: Instinctual Leap
skills.description:
Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same to move upward.
You can stay afloat for a short time by holding the skill key down along with down arrow key while in mid-air.
In Flora State, this skill shifts to Mystic Leap.
Float Command Lock: Right-click
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI. effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Knuckle Mastery

skills.name: Impending Death
skills.description: Unleashes Abyssal Aura when attacking with skills in Specter State. Abyssal Aura is created in proportion to the number of targets attacked, and pursues each target. If the number of targets attacked is greater than Abyssal Aura, it attacks in order starting with the boss with the highest HP. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Initiate Fusion
skills.description: Physical ability is enhanced as the Specter's power fuses with your own.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Improve your Strength by working out.

skills.name: Scarlet Buff

skills.name: Knuckle Booster

skills.name: Scarlet Charge Drive

skills.name: Grievous Wound

Shifts to Scarlet Charge Drive in Flora State.

Transforms your body into a blade, so you can leap and slash at enemies simultaneously. Can jump upward or downward by pressing directional key at the same time.
Shifts to Unstoppable Impulse in Flora State. Shares cooldown with Unstoppable Impulse.

skills.name: Vengeful Hate
skills.description:
Summon an Abyssal Aura in the form of a devastating blade.
Before using this skill, if you leave an Abyssal Mark where Impending Death hits, the blade will attack everything between the mark and the point where you use the skill.
Can only be used in Specter State. Unaffected by attack reflection, and unaffected by cooldown reset.
Turn on Auto Mode to automatically use Vengeful Hate whenever it is not on cooldown.
Auto Mode on/off: Right-click

skills.name: Creeping Terror
skills.description:
Use a passage through the abyss to dodge your enemy's attack. Shifts to Specter State when the skill is used. Spectra is not consumed while using this skill, but you can't use it while affected by Spectra Fatigue. Not affected by cooldown reset.
You can move while using the skill by holding down the key. Triggers Boundless Horror to obliterate surrounding enemies when the key is released.
Boundless Horror does damage to enemies with attack ignore and attack reflection.
Boundless Horror can chain into any other skill. Skills chained from Boundless Horror will be performed in place, unless you use the arrow keys to direct their attacks.

skills.name: Advanced Specter State
skills.description:
Using Master Corruption in Flora State while using a skill lets you consume Spectra to cancel that skill and shift to Specter State.
If you use Master Corruption while using Basic Charge Drive to cancel that skill, it could trigger Battle Frenzy.

skills.name: Swift Creeping Terror

skills.name: Floran Hero's Will

Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.

skills.name: Unending Hatred

skills.name: Divine Wrath

skills.name: Charge Spell Amplifier
skills.description: Amplifies Charge Spells. Applies a Charge Spell buff to party members and doubles the effect for yourself. The effect applies immediately even on the Charge Spell buff that was applied to yourself when Charge Spell Amplifier is used.

skills.description:
Unleash Abyssal magic during an attack. Charges Abyssal Cast when the attack hits. While casting, no enemy attack can knock you back.

skills.name: Unbridled Chaos

Causes you to move lightning fast, ruthlessly clawing at everything nearby.

skills.name: Blissful Restraint
skills.description:
Charge forward and create an Abyssal Prison that binds and holds the enemy. Activates Specter State upon using the skill. Cannot be used while Spectra Fatigue is in effect. Not affected by cooldown reset. Use the skill while pressing the Down Arrow key to create an Abyss Prison without charging. With Action Customization enabled, you can create an Abyss Prison without the arrow keys.
The enemy with the highest Max HP within range will be attacked first. Unaffected by attack reflection. Does not trigger Impending Death.
Affected enemies cannot be bound again by Blissful Restraint or other skills for 90 sec.
Does not collide with enemies while casting.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization on/off.

skills.name: Endless Agony
skills.description:
Opens the gate to the abyss, attacking forward for a moment, then summons an Abyssal Guard for the final blow. Shifts to Specter State when the skill is used. This skill does not consume Spectra, but cannot be used while Spectra Fatigue is in effect. Not affected by cooldown reset.
Endless Agony is unaffected by attack reflection. Abyssal Guard Attack does damage to enemies with attack ignore and attack reflection. When casting the skill, grants immunity to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses.
The final hit can chain into any other skill. Skills chained from the final hit will be performed in place, unless you use the arrow keys to direct their attacks, even if you've chained it with Endless Agony.

skills.name: Abyssal Recall
skills.description: Connects you directly to the source of Abyssal power to temporarily prevent consuming Spectra in your Specter State.

skills.name: Infinity Spell
skills.description: Exchange your HP for unlimited magical power. The additional Abyssal Aura created with Infinity Spell targets the boss with the highest HP first among the targets that were attacked.

skills.name: Devious Nightmare
skills.description:
A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Enhanced to Devious Dream during Specter State.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Devious Dream
skills.description:
A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Changed to Nightmare's Escape during Flora State.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Endlessly Starving Beast
skills.description: Summon a ravenous beast from the Abyssal depths and command it to devour everything in its path. From the moment the depths open, there's a certain delay until the beast arrives, but successful use of Specter's Force skills can hasten its arrival. The Endlessly Starving Beast is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

skills.name: Abyssal Recall
skills.description:
You recall the moment your consciousness accessed the Abyssal source of power.
Using this skill shifts you into Specter State, and prevents consuming Spectra for skills. However, this can't be used if your Spectra has already been depleted.
Use the skill again while the skill is cast to cancel the attack immediately. You can deal damage to enemies with Attack Ignore or Attack Reflection, but Impending Death will not activate.

Spectral energy is created instantly through the unlimited magical power gained when Infinity Spell is used.
